name: Moto Shachiku no Ore ga Bishoujo JK ni Hirowarete Amaama Iyasare Ero Dousei Seikatsu
original_name: 元社畜のオレが美少女JKに拾われて甘々癒されエロ同棲生活
source:
[b]"I'll pamper you as much as you like, okay♪"[/b]

Shin-ichi worked for a black company. While visiting a hospital because of his health condition, he saved a schoolgirl who was about to have an accident. He got injured and was hospitalized, resulting in him losing his job.

Madoka, the schoolgirl who was saved by Shin-ichi, offered him a surprising proposal.

"Would you like to live together at my house until you are recovered from your injuries? Please let me take care of you."

From that day on, she cooks for him, feeds him, takes a bath with him, sleeps together with him, and so on. Thus begins the domestic healing erotic life.

translation:
[b]“想撒多少娇都没关系，我会好好宠着你的♪”[/b]

慎一在一家黑心企业工作。因为身体不适去医院时，他救下了一名差点遭遇事故的女学生。自己却因此受伤住院，最后连工作也丢了。

被他救下的女学生小圆，向慎一提出了一个出乎意料的建议。

“在伤好之前，要不要先搬来我家一起住？请让我照顾你。”

从那天起，她亲手为他做饭，把饭菜喂到他嘴边，和他一起洗澡、一起入睡…一段疗愈又香艳的同居生活就这样开始了。
